items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: And B. She had done the same thing after he left and went up the road, whether we didn't know if he changed or not.

ctx.x: You see, that was it. Well I guess that was what you fellas were doing mostly at that time too, were you? Well, yeah.
Pretty much in that order. And B. She had done the same thing after he left and went up the road, whether we didn't know if he changed or not. No I don't think so.
He always did play the same style probably. Yeah.
